findings.evidence: The diff declares only `liftableSubgroup`, `toLiftable`, `coe_toLiftable`, `toLiftable_surjective` and `ker_toLiftable`; there is no `mem_liftableSubgroup`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem mem_liftableSubgroup {a : A} : a ∈ liftableSubgroup S ρ ↔ ∃ f : MulAut E, (f, a) ∈ S.compatibleLifts ρ`.
findings.issue: `liftableSubgroup` is defined as `(projection S ρ).range` but has no membership lemma, so users must unfold it to the range of a subtype projection to test whether an element lifts.

findings.evidence: Outside the `kernelCharacter` construction, `kernelDeviation` appears only in `kernelCharacter_rightHom`; every other later lemma uses `inl_kernelCharacter_rightHom`.
findings.fix: Make them `private`, or inline them into `kernelCharacter`, and keep `kernelCharacter_rightHom` stated without `kernelDeviation` (e.g. through `inl_kernelCharacter_rightHom`).
findings.issue: `kernelDeviation`, `inl_kernelDeviation`, `kernelDeviationHom`, `kernelDeviationHom_apply` and `ker_rightHom_le_ker_kernelDeviationHom` are construction steps for `kernelCharacter`. `kernelCharacter_rightHom` and `inl_kernelCharacter_rightHom` already characterize the result, so these steps add an `invFun`-based public surface that nothing else needs.

findings.evidence: Its proof uses only `rightHom_toCoverAut` and `MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply`. `Character.lean` declares `variable {N E G A : Type*} [CommGroup N] ...`.
findings.fix: Move it to `CompatibleLifts/Basic.lean` next to `rightHom_toCoverAut`, under `[Group N]`.
findings.issue: `rightHom_toCoverAut_symm` does not need a commutative kernel, but it is declared in the `[CommGroup N]` variable block, so it cannot be used for non-abelian `N`.

findings.evidence: Its statement mentions only `S.inl`, `S'.inl` and `F : S.Equiv S'`, and its proof uses `F.map_inl` and `Commute.map`; there is no `compatibleLifts`, `ρ` or `A`.
findings.fix: Move it to `TauCeti/GroupTheory/GroupExtension/Basic.lean` as `GroupExtension.Equiv.commute_inl` (or a similar name), taking the equivalence explicitly.
findings.issue: `central_of_equiv` is a general fact about `GroupExtension.Equiv` (equivalent extensions have equally central kernels) and does not involve compatible lifts. Placing it under `GroupExtension.CompatibleLifts` hides it from users of extension equivalences.

summary: The compatible-lifts API is mostly complete, but `liftableSubgroup` has no membership lemma, two internal helpers are public, and two general lemmas sit in the wrong place (one carries an unneeded `[CommGroup N]`).
